reader_notes: Idiomatic, well-paced Swedish popular science; idioms ("runnit ut i sanden", "bränna sina fingrar", "ett hål att stängsla in") land naturally and the glossary line for "skiktning" is genuinely useful. Numbers reconcile: "knappt sex tiondelar" as the ceiling, "knappt en tredjedel" the first winter, near six tenths the second.

Small friction on a careful second read: measurements run 2020-2023 and "varje vinter mättes", but only two winters' yields are ever characterised ("den första", "den andra"). The third winter is silently absent. Does not affect any question.

Q3 uses the standard whole-text-thesis frame: options A and D are both literally true statements lifted from the passage, and only the stem's "som helhet" separates them from B. Fair as written, but it is the item that leans hardest on stem wording.
